targets.name: MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.finite_weighted_exp_envelope
targets.type:
MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.finite_weighted_exp_envelope
  (model : MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.FiniteSpectralModel) (weight excess : Fin model.dimension → ℝ)
  (delta time : ℝ) (hDelta : 0 < delta) (hTime : 0 ≤ time) (hWeight : ∀ (j : Fin model.dimension), 0 ≤ weight j)
  (hExcess : ∀ (j : Fin model.dimension), 0 ≤ excess j) :
  0 < delta ∧
    MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.spectralSum model weight excess delta time ≤
      Real.exp (-delta * time) * ∑ j, weight j

targets.name: MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.log_gap_positive

targets.name: MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.conservative_log_lower_bound

targets.name: MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.TransferEnclosure.nonvacuum_lower_bound
targets.type:
MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.TransferEnclosure.nonvacuum_lower_bound
  {model : MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.FiniteSpectralModel}
  (certificate : MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.TransferEnclosure model) (j : Fin model.dimension)
  (hNonvacuum : j ∈ certificate.excited) :
  0 < certificate.gap ∧
    (1 - certificate.ratio) / certificate.timeStep ≤ certificate.gap ∧ certificate.gap ≤ certificate.energy j

targets.name: MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.TransferEnclosure.nonvacuum_exp_envelope
targets.type:
MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.TransferEnclosure.nonvacuum_exp_envelope
  {model : MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.FiniteSpectralModel}
  (certificate : MathScope.M3.Gauge.RealSpectral.TransferEnclosure model) (weight : Fin model.dimension → ℝ) (time : ℝ)
  (hTime : 0 ≤ time) (hWeight : ∀ j ∈ certificate.excited, 0 ≤ weight j) :
  0 < certificate.gap ∧
    ∑ j ∈ certificate.excited, weight j * Real.exp (-certificate.energy j * time) ≤
      Real.exp (-certificate.gap * time) * ∑ j ∈ certificate.excited, weight j

projectionCounterexample.analyticReason: At x4=0 the squared distances to centers +1/2 and -1/2 are equal for all x1,x2,x3; at x4=1 they differ. Thus the slice density agrees everywhere, yet the four-dimensional sources differ.
projectionCounterexample.marginalAlsoIdentical: Integration over the entire x4 axis is translation invariant. A finite-window marginal need not agree unless the window symmetry supplies a separate argument.
projectionCounterexample.conclusion: A scalar 3D image does not determine the full 4D connection or its quantum spectrum.
projectionCounterexample.leanScope: The shipped point-projection theorem proves noninjectivity. The separate BPST density identity is derived from the displayed analytic formula, not claimed as kernel-checked Real analysis.
